title: Formation energy contribution schema
description: Total energy contribution of one material used in formation energy calculation.

formula.description: formula or label for the material used in the formation energy calculation

n_atoms.description: number of atoms in the material

is_elemental.description: whether the material is an elemental reference

total_energy_per_atom.description: total energy per atom of the material

precision_value.description: precision value for the total energy property

precision_metric.description: metric used to report total energy precision
